description: Player statistics keyed by lowercased full name. Every value must carry its own source URL and fetch timestamp. Empty objects mean 'not sourced' — the engine treats a missing field as unscoreable and never estimates it.

field_contract.rank: integer, official ATP/WTA singles ranking at fetch time
field_contract.odds: { decimal, american } — match moneyline, cross-referenced across >=2 books
field_contract.firstSetOdds: { decimal, american } — first set winner market
field_contract.handicapOdds: { decimal, american } — games handicap market for this player's line
field_contract.form.last5: ['W'|'L', ...] most recent first, last month only
field_contract.form.tournamentWinStreak: integer, wins in the current event
field_contract.form.firstSetWinRateLast10: float 0-1, last 10 matches on this surface
field_contract.form.documentedSlowStarter: bool, only from a citable source
field_contract.surface.dominantMarginGames: { bigWins, of } — wins by 6+ games in the last N surface matches
field_contract.rest.physicalConcernCited: bool, only from a citable source

collection_status.rank: NOT SOURCED — no ranking feed has been verified reachable from this environment
collection_status.odds: NOT SOURCED — OLBG does not expose structured prices in server-rendered HTML; a price aggregator is required
collection_status.form: NOT SOURCED — the standard free ATP/WTA match CSVs are no longer publicly reachable (see docs/IRREGULARITIES.md IR-02)
